name: Welcomer
description: Greets every new member with a message in a channel you choose.
about: Whenever someone joins your server, the bot posts a message that mentions them in the channel you pick. It's a normal Send message block, so you can change the text, turn it into an embed with the member's avatar, or show how many members the server has.
Discord only tells bots about new members when the Server Members Intent is on. Turn it on under Bot in the Discord Developer Portal, otherwise the welcome message never runs.

faq.question: Why doesn't the bot send a welcome message?
faq.answer: Most often the Server Members Intent is off in the Discord Developer Portal. Also check that the bot can see the welcome channel and send messages in it.

faq.question: Can I welcome members with a DM instead?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace the Send message block with a direct message block in the editor. Members who don't accept DMs from server members won't get it.

faq.question: Can new members get a role too?
faq.answer: Yes. Add an Add role to member block after the message. If members should click a button before they get the role, use the Verification template instead.
